description: This file declares classes and structures related to port-based channel estimation in a 5G NR PHY layer, including DM-RS pattern configuration, estimation results, and the main estimator interface.

classes.name: port_channel_estimator
classes.description: Interface for a DM-RS-based channel estimator for one receive antenna port, including configuration and computation methods.

classes.name: port_channel_estimator_results
classes.description: Provides access to estimated channel coefficients and metrics such as EPRE, SINR, RSRP, CFO, and time alignment.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Performs channel estimation given a resource grid, port, pilots, and configuration, returning a results interface.

methods.name: get_symbol_ch_estimate
methods.description: Retrieves the estimated channel coefficients for a specific OFDM symbol and transmission layer.

methods.name: get_symbol_ch_estimate
methods.description: Retrieves the estimated channel coefficients for a specific OFDM symbol, layer, and resource element mask.

methods.name: get_snr
methods.description: Returns the estimated SNR in linear scale.

methods.name: get_rsrp
methods.description: Returns the estimated RSRP for a specified transmission layer.

methods.name: get_cfo_Hz
methods.description: Returns the estimated carrier frequency offset in Hz, if available.

methods.name: get_time_alignment
methods.description: Returns the estimated time alignment in PHY time units.
